description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV1 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It uses Google Test framework to verify reading video and audio data segments, including setting up shared memory, writing test data, and validating the read results.

classes.name: DataReaderV1Tests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing DataReaderV1's reading capabilities, including setup, teardown, and specific test methods for reading video and audio data.

methods.name: writeVideoData
methods.description: Prepares shared memory and writes a video media segment frame for testing reading.

methods.name: readVideoData
methods.description: Reads video data from shared memory and verifies the correctness of the retrieved media segment.

methods.name: writeAudioData
methods.description: Prepares shared memory and writes an audio media segment frame for testing reading.

methods.name: readAudioData
methods.description: Reads audio data from shared memory and verifies the correctness of the retrieved media segment.
